notes: Italian: shipwreck report. Role-before-count phrasing ('dispersi almeno 12 persone') -- was a confirmed count-extraction miss until core.intel.humanitarian_recognition's role patterns were made bidirectional (docs/fixes.md M2.1).

input: Détresse maritime signalée par une embarcation en difficulté près des côtes tunisiennes
notes: French: distress signal. KNOWN GAP (not fixed by this PR): core.intel.geoextract.is_direct_distress_call()/humanitarian._case_type() have no French distress-call patterns, so this currently scores as a false negative (unknown_humanitarian/needs_review/review) -- is_distress() alone (the loose ingestion prefilter, scored separately above) does still catch it. Extending the direct-call patterns to French/Italian is a follow-up PR; recorded here rather than silently patched so the scorer keeps reporting it honestly.

input: Boat missing since yesterday evening, no contact with the 45 people believed aboard
notes: missing boat, no direct SOS marker. 'believed aboard' filler between count and role marker -- was a confirmed count-extraction miss until core.intel.humanitarian_recognition's _QTY pattern learned to tolerate a small filler-verb set (docs/fixes.md M2.1). A missing-case-type report is itself an active, ongoing search situation -- was falling through to needs_review until case_type==missing was added to the lifecycle=active condition (docs/fixes.md M2.1).

notes: docs/prompt.md hard negative -- org name contains the literal keyword 'sos'. Was a confirmed false positive; fixed by reusing geoextract._SOS_MARKER_RE's existing org-name exclusion in is_distress() (docs/ALERT_RECOGNITION_BASELINE.md).

notes: policy/news mentioning rescue operations in the abstract, not a live incident. Was a confirmed false positive ('rescue operation' singular matched substring inside 'rescue operations' plural); fixed by removing the keyword from DISTRESS_KW as too weak/ambiguous alone (docs/ALERT_RECOGNITION_BASELINE.md).

input: Last year's shipwreck anniversary was marked with a vigil in Lampedusa
notes: retrospective/memorial mention of 'shipwreck', not an active incident. Was a confirmed false positive (bare 'shipwreck' keyword ignored tense/context); fixed with a shared retrospective-commemoration exclusion also applied to is_direct_distress_call(), which had the identical defect (docs/ALERT_RECOGNITION_BASELINE.md). expected_lifecycle corrected from the non-canonical 'concluded' to null (docs/fixes.md M2.1) -- a non-operational advocacy post has no incident lifecycle to score, same convention as the other hard negatives here.
